# Pinned plotting dependency

`plotly-3.1.0.min.js` is Plotly.js 3.1.0, downloaded from the primary distribution endpoint `https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-3.1.0.min.js` on 20 September 2026. Its SHA-256 is `122e3be346d66616944d0b83eaaf7242581508c3c1cfa0995a17af0d83eff770`.

`PLOTLY-LICENSE.txt` is the MIT licence from the corresponding `v3.1.0` tag of the Plotly.js repository. Its SHA-256 is `8c45d9eaf50c2f72dd9c7ab9ef440788ba58a3538484b5c51c1f17d5128752e7`.

The build embeds the bundle and licence in `density_surface.html`. Opening or rebuilding the graph does not download any scripts or data. Software documentation is listed separately from the scientific bibliography in `research/references.md`.
